SELECT equip_method_crews.cal_trans_code, equip_method_crews.method, equip_method_crews.is_primary, equip_method_crews.number_required, equip_method_crews.percent_time_used,
equip_available.category as category, equip_available.brand as brand, equip_available.model as model_master, equip_available.productivity_per_hour as productivity_hour, equip_available.cal_trans_rate as ct_rate, equip_available.percent_ct_per_hour as percent_ct_hour
FROM equip_method_crews
INNER JOIN equip_available
ON equip_method_crews.cal_trans_code=equip_available.cal_trans_code
ORDER BY equip_method_crews.method

SELECT cal_trans_code
FROM equip_method_crews
WHERE is_primary = 't' AND method = #value#

SELECT productivity_per_hour
FROM equip_available
WHERE cal_trans_code = #value#

SELECT cal_trans_code
FROM new_equip_available
WHERE company_id = #companyID# AND is_on_project = 't' AND project_numb = #jobID#

SELECT cal_trans_code
FROM used_equip_available
WHERE company_id = #companyID# AND is_on_project = 't' AND project_numb = #jobID#

SELECT cal_trans_code
FROM rental_equip_available
WHERE company_id = #companyID# AND is_on_project = 't' AND project_numb = #jobID#
